evals.prompt: I am sizing a buy. Planned entry ₹1,200, stop ₹1,196, risk budget ₹2,000, position-value cap ₹3,00,000. The live quote just before I send is ₹1,203. How many shares, and which limit set the size?
expectations: Measures stop distance from the higher of planned entry and the fresh quote (1,203), so the distance is 7, not 4
Risk cap is 285 shares, position-value cap is 249 shares, so the quantity is 249 and the position-value cap is the binding one
Names the cap that decided the quantity
must_match: (?i:position[- ]value|position[- ]size)[^.\n]{0,60}(?i:binding|binds|decid|determin|smallest|lowest|minimum|tightest|limiting|wins|governs|set the size|sets the size|set the quantity|sets the quantity)|(?i:binding|binds|decid|determin|smallest|lowest|minimum|tightest|limiting|wins|governs)[^.\n]{0,60}(?i:position[- ]value|position[- ]size)

evals.prompt: My sizing for a stock future comes out at 4,010 units. The lot size is 25 and the exchange freeze quantity is 1,800. What do I send?
expectations: Rounds down to a whole number of lots: 4,000 (160 lots), never up to 4,025
4,000 is above the freeze quantity, so it is split into slices that are each at most 1,800 (a lot multiple, so 1,800, 1,800 and 400), or refused
Notes lot size and freeze quantity come from the exchange file, not constants

evals.prompt: For a buy on a stock with a ₹0.10 tick, my code rounds the stop 1196.46 and the target 1210.97 to the nearest 2 decimals. What should the stop and target be on the tick grid, and which direction does each round?
expectations: Stop 1196.40: rounded down, away from entry, so risk is not understated
Target 1210.90: rounded down, toward entry, so the target is reachable
Round on the instrument's own tick size, not 2 decimals

evals.prompt: I cap my intraday margin as order value divided by 5, because my broker gives 5x leverage on MIS. Is that a safe way to compute the margin limit in my sizing code?
expectations: No: a fixed multiplier is not safe; margin changes by instrument, exchange rules, broker policy and existing positions
Take margin from the broker's margin API or calculator at order time, for the actual order (Kite: /margins/orders)
Re-check the required margin for the final quantity and refuse if it exceeds available margin; refuse if the call fails

evals.prompt: My sizing function receives a quote stamped 40 seconds ago and no tick size for the stock. To keep the bot trading I default the tick to 0.05 and size from the stale quote. Is that okay?
expectations: No: fail closed. Raise or refuse and place nothing on a stale quote or missing tick size
Tick size comes from the exchange's per-security master, and it varies by security and changes over time
A person may re-quote under the stale-quote policy; a machine is blocked

evals.prompt: I am sizing a sell (short) on a stock with a ₹0.10 tick and entry ₹1,196.60. My code sends the stop 1203.54 and the target 1190.03 exactly as computed. What should the stop and target be on the tick grid, and which way does each round?
expectations: Stop 1203.60: rounded up, away from entry, so the risk is not understated
Target 1190.10: rounded up, toward entry, so the target is reachable
Round on the instrument's own tick size
